Lemma 3.7, Lemma 3.9: Convergence
nodes.statement:
Let us assume that \crefrange{ass:ic}{ass:V} hold, the quadrature weights satisfy \crefrange{ass:pos-mono}{ass:convexity}, and the CFL condition 2.6 holds with the CFL ratio $\lambda\coloneqq \tau/h$ fixed. Let $\{\rho_j^n\}_{j\in\mathbb{Z}}^{n\geq0}$ and $\{W_j^n\}_{j\in\mathbb{Z}}^{n\geq0}$ be the numerical solutions constructed with the numerical scheme \crefrange{eq:godunov}{eq:ini_cond_discrete}. Then the approximate solution $W_{{\varepsilon},h}$ constructed from $\{W_j^n\}_{j\in\mathbb{Z}}^{n\geq0}$ using 2.7, as ${\varepsilon},h \searrow 0$, converges strongly in $\mathrm{L}^1_{\mathrm{loc}}(\mathbb{R}_+\times \mathbb{R})$ and almost everywhere, up to a subsequence, to a limit point $\rho^*\in \mathrm{L}^1_{\mathrm{loc}}(\mathbb{R}_+\times \mathbb{R})$. Moreover, $0 \le \rho^* \le 1$ almost everywhere.

Let us assume that \crefrange{ass:ic}{ass:V} hold, the quadrature weights satisfy \crefrange{ass:pos-mono}{eq:quad_weight_localize}, and the CFL condition 2.6 holds with the CFL ratio $\lambda\coloneqq \tau/h$ fixed. Let $\{\rho_j^n\}_{j\in\mathbb{Z}}^{n\geq0}$ and $\{W_j^n\}_{j\in\mathbb{Z}}^{n\geq0}$ be the numerical solutions constructed with the numerical scheme \crefrange{eq:godunov}{eq:ini_cond_discrete}. Then any limit point $\rho^\ast$ (as ${\varepsilon},h \searrow 0$) of the approximate solution $W_{{\varepsilon},h}$ constructed from $\{W_j^n\}_{j\in\mathbb{Z}}^{n\geq0}$ using 2.7, in the strong topology of $\mathrm{L}^1_{\mathrm{loc}}$, is the unique entropy solution of 1.6.

Theorem 4.7: $\mathrm{L}^1$ -contraction
nodes.statement:
Let us assume that 1.3 holds, the nonlocal kernel $\gamma \coloneqq \mathds{1}_{]-\infty,0]}(\cdot) \exp(\cdot)$, and the initial data $\rho_0,\, \widetilde{\rho}_0$ satisfy 1.2 with $\rho_0-\widetilde{\rho}_0\in\mathrm{L}^1(\mathbb{R})$. Let $\rho_{\varepsilon}, \, \widetilde{\rho}_\varepsilon$ be the solutions of 1.1, with the nonlocal impacts $W_{\varepsilon},\, \widetilde{W}_\varepsilon$ defined as in 1.4.
Then the following $\mathrm{L}^1$-contraction property holds: 
\[
\|W_\varepsilon(t,\cdot) - \widetilde{W}_\varepsilon(t,\cdot)\|_{\mathrm{L}^1} \le \|W_{\varepsilon}(0,\cdot) - \widetilde{W}_{\varepsilon}(0,\cdot)\|_{\mathrm{L}^1}.
\]
